title: unified-rollouts: enhance weighted canary, shadow probing, and automated rollback workflows
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Enhances unified rollouts with improved weighted canary staging, shadow traffic probing, multi-metric autorollback policies, and additional e2e stability guards. No breaking changes.
commits: feat(rollouts): add weighted canary algorithm and percent-based routing
feat(rollouts): add shadow probing harness and quorum-based metrics
feat(autorollback): multi-metric policy engine with configurable quorums
fix(autorollback): tighten threshold evaluation to prevent premature rollbacks
test(e2e): staged shadow + canary scenarios and stability guards
docs: rollout docs, examples, and runbook updates
description:
Motivation: production rollouts must be predictable and safe. This PR improves unified rollouts by adding a weighted canary strategy, a staged shadow probing harness, and a more robust automated rollback engine that supports multi-metric quorum evaluation. It addresses recurring incidents where single-metric noise caused unnecessary rollbacks and where shadow probing produced noisy signals without quorum enforcement.

Summary of changes: added a new weighted canary scheduler that supports percent-based splits and gradual ramping; implemented a shadow probing harness that drives real traffic to candidate models without affecting end-user routing and aggregates probe results with configurable quorums; extended the autorollback engine to evaluate composite metrics (latency p95, error-rate, quality delta) and require a quorum before triggering rollback; improved observability (new rollout-level metrics, per-route metric breakdowns, and tracing hooks); added e2e tests and stability guards to reduce flakiness.

Checklist:
- [x] Weighted canary algorithm and gating (pkg/rollouts/strategy)
- [x] Shadow probing harness + CLI for manual probes (pkg/rollouts/probing, cmd/rollouts/probing_cli)
- [x] Multi-metric autorollback engine with quorum support (pkg/rollouts/autorollback)
- [x] Observability: metrics + dashboard updates (observability/metrics, webapp)
- [x] e2e tests for staged shadow and weighted canary (e2e/)
- [x] Docs and runbook updates (docs/)

Testing notes: ran unit tests and integration tests locally. e2e staged-shadow initially timed out in CI due to test infra flake; reran CI after increasing probe timeout and flake guard — all CI checks passed on the final run. Benchmarks show no regression in median latency for common workloads; slight throughput improvement in batched canary flows due to more efficient routing code.

Operational notes: the new rollout policy requires an operator-configurable quorum setting (defaults to 2/3) and a minimal observation window. The rollout controller will not perform a rollback until quorum and window criteria are met. There is a temporary feature flag (rollouts.v2_autorollback_enabled) to toggle behavior for staged rollout. See docs/runbooks/rollout-failure-runbook.md for troubleshooting steps.

Related: ENG-2021 (weighted canary), ENG-2103 (autorollback stability), SUP-4132 (incident follow-up).
review_comments: Ethan Morris (review): high-level LGTM. Please add an integration test to cover a noisy latency signal with insufficient quorum to ensure we don't rollback incorrectly.
Aisha Patel (author): added e2e test 'staged_shadow.test.ts' that simulates noisy p95 spikes and verifies quorum prevents rollback. Also tightened evaluation windows.
Li Wei (review): small nit on metric naming and a comment about exposing the default quorum as a top-level config. Suggested default 66%.
Aisha Patel (author): exposed default quorum in charts/rollouts/values.yaml and updated docs. Reply: default set to 0.66 with note in docs about tuning.

Sofia Ramirez (review): asked for an extra guard to avoid observer-driven rollback during region-wide controller restarts. Added a safety gate: require controller to observe consistent data from >1 collector before taking action.
Aisha Patel (author): implemented controller restart safety gate in autorollback/engine.go; added unit tests.
merge_commit_summary:
squash: unified-rollouts: enhance weighted canary, shadow probing, and autorollback (Aisha Patel)

Adds weighted canary scheduling, shadow probing harness, multi-metric quorum-based autorollback, observability, and e2e tests.
testing_instructions: Deploy to staging with rollouts.v2_autorollback_enabled=false first. Smoke test weighted canary via CLI. Enable feature flag and run e2e/rollouts/staged_shadow.test.ts. Monitor rollout_metrics.prom and web dashboard for quorum decisions.
notes: No schema or API breaking changes. Backwards compatible with existing rollout configs.
